_comment: Sizing rule for the adaptive transverse box, fitted on 141 events (b = 1.46-13.31 fm) across 8 batches spanning T_freeze, normalization, tau and b-max. R_rms_trento is the RMS radius of the TRENTo output BEFORE free-streaming, which is what is available before MUSIC starts. L = k_tail*(r_rms_predicted + n_sigma*sigma) must exceed both the freeze-out surface max radius and the IC R99.9.
